uncertain: The 'Required Course(s)' group contains multiple distinct requirement blocks (Core courses, Capstone/Research options, Chemistry, Biology, Math, Physics, CS, Language). The 'required_credits' field is set to 3 (from the Capstone note row) because the table structure merges these disparate requirements under one header without a total sum row. The actual total credits for this group is the sum of all individual course credits listed.

The 'Elective(s)' group lists specific courses (OCES 2201, etc.) but the note says 'Any OCES courses at 3000/4000-level'. The listed courses are likely examples or specific electives allowed, but the requirement is open-ended. The 'required_credits' is 0 as no minimum credit total is explicitly stated in the 'Minimum credit' column for this specific group header, though options imply specific counts.

MATH 1012, OCES 2001, OCES 3201, OCES 3203, and OCES 4205 are marked as deleted in the remarks but still appear in the requirement lists. They are included in the JSON as they appear in the text, but users should note they may not be available.

The 'International Research Enrichment Track' is presented as a 'Track Study' with its own 'Required Course(s)' table. It is treated as a separate group. The note 'Students in the IRE Track should also take SCIE 3500 and SCIE 4500' refers back to the main Required Courses group.

total_required_credits (21.0) is a computed value: the sum of the required_credits of all groups in this file. The PDF does not state a single overall minimum total for this program, so this figure is derived by summation and may double-count where optional tracks/options are listed as separate groups.
